Main
================================================================================

Maicel E. Monzón-Pérez, MD, PhD {#title}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Biostatistician & Epidemiologist · Reproducible quantitative evidence for public health, nutrition and clinical research

Medical doctor and biostatistician (second-degree specialist, PhD in Medical Sciences) with 20 years turning complex health data into decision-ready evidence. Recent WFP work: analysis of a national household income and expenditure survey to estimate apparent micronutrient intake and model large-scale food fortification scenarios, delivered as a reproducible R pipeline and an e-learning platform. Background in clinical trial statistics and regulatory review.

Experience {data-icon=suitcase}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Consultant, Programme Policy (Nutrition)

World Food Programme, Dominican Republic Country Office

Santo Domingo

2026

- Delivered early the feasibility assessment of the 2018 National Household Income and Expenditure Survey (ENGIH) for nutrition analysis, and extended it to an advanced micronutrient intake analysis.
- Built a reproducible R pipeline (survey design, paired differences between scenarios with confidence intervals) estimating the potential contribution of national standards, WHO-recommended levels and rice fortification to iron, folate, zinc and vitamin A adequacy.
- Detected that one survey section records weights rather than consumed quantities, preventing a biased intake estimate.
- Designed and deployed an e-learning platform with modular R code, scripts and question banks ([fortificacion.netlify.app](https://fortificacion.netlify.app)); presented results to WFP teams and partners.
